messages:
priya: Hey team — customer C-9423 reporting mid-stream disconnects (partial JSON output) when switching networks on iOS. Happens ~10-30s into stream. App in foreground. Any quick triage ideas? :thinking:

marco: saw this earlier. Repro steps on our side: start stream on 4G, flip to WiFi, stream dies with socket close. Proxy logs show 499 from client. iOS SDK v0.9.2.

davinder: can you paste a minimal repro and the SSE frames/headers? 499 usually means client closed connection, but could be our client lib hitting a timeout and aborting. Which TL?

priya: repro steps below — short: 1) start generation with streaming=true 2) stream ~15 tokens 3) toggle WiFi on iPhone 12 4) client sees close, app logs "socket closed" and partial JSON returned.

Code snippet (request body):
```
POST /v1/stream/generate
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{ "model":"redwood-1-std", "stream": true, "input": "Summarize the following..." }
```

marco: paste from our nginx error log around same time: 
```
2026/02/18 14:12:21 [error] 12345#0: *6789 client prematurely closed connection, client: 10.1.2.3, server: inference, request: "GET /v1/stream/generate HTTP/1.1", host: "api.redwood.ai"
```

marco: and app-side stack: "NSURLSessionTask finished with error - code: -1011" then later "NSPOSIXErrorDomain:61" (connection reset)

davinder: -1011 is 411? but -1011 often maps to HTTP error. The key is whether the client is cancelling the request or the OS tears the socket when interface changes. iOS sometimes kills sockets on cellular <-> wifi switch. Does the SDK auto-reconnect?

sarah: SDK v0.9.2 has a background handling bug where we cancel tasks on reachability change. We added a fix in main branch to keep streams open and attempt HTTP/2 connection migration instead of cancel. Could be hitting that.

priya: customer is on our hosted API (eu-west). They reported token TTL ~3600s. Not using proxying from their side. They see partial JSON chunk that is valid but incomplete (missing closing array).

davinder: next steps: (A) reproduce with iOS device + Charles proxy to simulate network flip (B) capture full SSE frames and connection trace (C) try with curl long-lived connection from laptop and toggle NIC to compare. If curl survives, likely SDK cancels.

priya: I can run the Charles repro tomorrow and share HAR. Also raising P1 for customer — impacted production. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/C-9423 (assigned to Priya)

infra-bot: deploy-bot: noticed nginx 1.22.1 -> 1.23.0 roll last night on eu-west pool. No automatic rollbacks. Recommend check for client-abort regressions.

marco: good catch. davinder, can we verify whether our edge changed keepalive or http2 settings after the roll? If nginx now forces TCP FIN on client disconnect rather than graceful GOAWAY, behavior differs on iOS.

davinder: will check config diff and run a small AB test in staging. If SDK cancels on reachability change, we should patch SDK asap (sarah already has PR). Also will instrument server to log TLS-level connection migrations and http2 GOAWAY events.

priya: action items captured: 1) Priya -> reproduce + HAR (by EOD tomorrow) 2) Davinder -> config diff + instrumenting (ETA next 24h) 3) Sarah -> land SDK fix to stop cancelling tasks on reachability + publish patch (ETA 48h) 4) Marco -> correlate customer time with edge deploys and share logs.

marco: quick mitigation for customer: recommend they disable automatic network switching in client or retry the request on failure with resume semantics. Sending sample retry wrapper: `streamRequest().onError(retryWithBackoff)`

priya: I'll inform customer of the mitigation and update ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
